[EN] We left a lot of weapons out there on the battlefield, and a lot of comrades, too. We can't get our friends back, but having those weapons back would make a big difference.

Will you help?
[ES] Dejamos muchas armas en el campo de batalla, y también a muchos camaradas. No podemos recuperar a nuestros amigos, pero recuperar esas armas marcaría una gran diferencia.

¿Nos ayudarás?

[EN] Bless you, !

If we're as brave as you, we'll be all right.
[ES] ¡Dios te bendiga, !

Si somos tan valientes como tú, saldremos adelante.

[EN] We really need those weapons.
[ES] De verdad necesitamos esas armas.
